svg.title: Bottom-of-funnel comparison traffic to net settled commissions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-click-to-commission-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: Bottom-of-funnel comparison traffic to net settled commissions; subtitle: Illustrative monthly cohort of 10,000 commercial-investigation visitors; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Invented nested cohort counts illustrating high-intent B2B comparison math; not representative earnings.; caption: Bottom-of-funnel switching and pricing queries convert 5x-10x higher than generic informational listicles.; stages: label: BOFU hub visitors; value: 10,000; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Visitors landing on '[Incumbent] pricing calculator', 'vs', and mid-year migration guides.; label: Calculator / table users; value: 5,800; numeric value: 5800.0; detail: Engaged buyers filtering vendor pricing tiers by seat count, state footprint, or transaction volume.; label: Outbound merchant clicks; value: 4,600; numeric value: 4600.0; detail: Pre-qualified clicks routed with first-party click_id across Primary, Runner-Up, and Fallback offers.; label: Gross S2S conversions; value: 253; numeric value: 253.0; detail: Combined qualified B2B demos, funded fintech accounts, and recurring SaaS subscriptions reported.; label: Settled post-scrub payouts; value: 215; numeric value: 215.0; detail: Locked payable conversions after 15% duplicate-CRM, invalid-lead, and 45-day cancellation scrubs.
